items.headline: Bitcoin Falls Below $98K as Crypto Market Faces Profit-Taking
items.summary: Major cryptocurrencies declined overnight as traders locked in gains from the recent rally. BTC dropped 3.2% while ETH fell 1.8%.

items.headline: NVIDIA Set to Report Q4 Earnings Amid AI Spending Boom
items.summary: Analysts expect NVIDIA to post record revenue of $38.5B, driven by surging demand for AI training chips from hyperscalers.

items.headline: AI Supply Chain Startup NexaFlow Enters Series A Discussions
items.summary: NexaFlow, which uses AI to optimize supply chain logistics, is reportedly in talks with Tier 1 VCs for a $30M Series A round.

items.headline: Fed Officials Signal Patience on Rate Cuts Amid Sticky Inflation
items.summary: Federal Reserve governors emphasized data dependency, suggesting rate cuts may be delayed until clear evidence of inflation returning to target.

items.headline: Solana DeFi TVL Hits All-Time High of $18B
items.summary: Solana ecosystem DeFi protocols reached record total value locked, with Raydium and Marinade leading the charge.

items.headline: Apple Services Revenue Grows 18% as Hardware Sales Stabilize
items.summary: Apple reported strong services growth driven by App Store, Apple TV+, and Apple Pay. iPhone sales showed modest recovery in Greater China.

items.headline: Tesla Robotaxi Approval Expected in Austin by Q2 2026
items.summary: Regulatory sources indicate Tesla may receive its first autonomous ride-hailing permit in Austin, Texas, as early as April.

items.headline: Global Carbon Credit Market Surges Past $1 Trillion
items.summary: The voluntary carbon market has grown 40% year-over-year, with compliance markets driving institutional adoption and price discovery.

items.headline: Microsoft Azure Revenue Grows 32% on AI Workload Demand
items.summary: Microsoft cloud segment exceeded expectations with AI-related workloads accounting for over 10% of Azure consumption revenue.

items.headline: Ethereum Layer 2 Networks Process More Transactions Than Mainnet
items.summary: Combined L2 throughput now exceeds Ethereum mainnet by 5x, with Arbitrum and Base leading in daily active addresses.

items.headline: Decentralized Identity Startup VaultEdge Joins Y Combinator W26
items.summary: VaultEdge, building privacy-preserving identity verification for fintech, was accepted into Y Combinator Winter 2026 batch.

items.headline: Amazon AWS Launches Next-Gen Graviton5 Chips
items.summary: Amazon Web Services unveiled its latest custom silicon, promising 40% better price-performance for cloud workloads.

items.headline: US Consumer Confidence Rises for Third Straight Month
items.summary: The Conference Board Consumer Confidence Index rose to 118.2, with consumers expressing optimism about the labor market.

items.headline: Japan Central Bank Hints at Further Rate Normalization
items.summary: BOJ Governor signaled readiness for additional rate increases if wage growth continues, potentially strengthening the yen.

items.headline: Bitcoin Mining Difficulty Reaches New All-Time High
items.summary: Network difficulty adjusted upward 4.2% as hash rate continues to climb post-halving, squeezing less efficient miners.

items.headline: Private Markets See Record Dry Powder at $4.2 Trillion
items.summary: PE and VC firms are sitting on unprecedented levels of uninvested capital, with AI and climate tech attracting the most interest.
